:::{#sol-complement-null-space-practice}

By @thm-complement-null-space, $\mathcal{C}(\matr{A})^\perp = \mathcal{N}(\tp{\matr{A}})$.
For $\vecf{y} = (y_1, y_2, y_3)$,

$$
\tp{\matr{A}}\vecf{y} = \sbmat{1 & 0 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & 1} \sbmat{y_1 \\ y_2 \\ y_3} = \sbmat{y_1 + y_3 \\ y_2 + y_3},
$$

which is $\vzero_2$ exactly when $y_1 = y_2 = -y_3$.
So

$$
\mathcal{C}(\matr{A})^\perp = \operatorname{span}\cb{(-1, -1, 1)}.
$$

As a check, $(-1, -1, 1)$ is [orthogonal](linear-algebra-vectors.qmd#def-orthogonal-vectors)
to both [columns of $\matr{A}$](linear-algebra-matrices.qmd#def-matrix-column):
$-1 + 0 + 1 = 0$ and $0 - 1 + 1 = 0$.

:::
